title: procedural_case.status_changed event payload (v1)
description: PACK-09, ADR-041/ADR-042. Produced by epd2_compliance_service.events. Minimum payload only: identifiers, enum values, timestamps and reason codes. It never carries a document or its bytes, a ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference, an authentication secret, an identity/eID/KYC attribute, a free-text case narrative, or the name of any natural person (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Carries no party reference at all: which parties hold which procedural role on a case is deliberately not broadcast, only the case's own identity, type, workflow, status and version.
